image_description: A close-up macro shot of a sliced fig. The fruit is cut longitudinally, revealing the internal structure. The exterior skin is green transitioning to yellow near the cut. The interior displays a dense cluster of reddish-brown seeds embedded in amber/pink fleshy pulp. The background is blurred (bokeh), showing hints of a patterned surface.
